model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е озаглавена "Hidden State Mean" и илюстрира промените в абсолютната средна стойност на скритото състояние през различните слоеве на модел. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer", има линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23 и етикети, разположени през интервал от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean", също с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, с етикети през интервал от 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

Първата линия, в син цвят и с пунктиран стил (тире-тире), представлява "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва при стойност близо до 0 при слой 0, леко нараства до около 0.2–0.3 в диапазона от слой 2 до слой 8, след което остава относително стабилна около 0.2 до слой 10. От слой 10 нататък линията започва постепенно да нараства, достигайки около 0.5 при слой 15 и около 0.5–0.6 при слой 18. След слой 18 се наблюдава рязко нарастване, като стойността достига връх от приблизително 4.3 при слой 21, последвано от лек спад до около 2.5 при слой 23.

Втората линия, в оранжев цвят и с точков (пунктиран) стил, представлява "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон на оста X, с минимални колебания, и при слой 23 достига стойност от приблизително 0.05–0.1.

Третата линия, в зелен цвят и с тире-точка стил, представлява "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Тя също остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон, като при последните слоеве (около слой 22–23) показва леко увеличение до приблизително 0.08–0.1. Оранжевата и зелената линия са визуално почти припокриващи се в по-голямата част от графиката.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis represents "Layer" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Abs Mean" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in the range of layers 3 through 9, remains relatively flat around 0.2 through layer 10, then begins increasing more steeply from approximately 0.3 at layer 12 to about 0.5 at layer 17, followed by a sharp rise to approximately 2.6 at layer 21, before dipping slightly to around 2.5 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, staying below approximately 0.1 across the entire range. The third line, shown in green with a dash-dot line style, represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it similarly remains near 0 across all layers, closely tracking the orange line, with values reaching at most approximately 0.1 near layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Abs Mean," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 or 1.0.

Three lines are shown. The first is a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate" with a reported average of 0.71. It starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in the range of layers 2–8, remains relatively steady around 0.2 through layers 8–12, then begins increasing more steeply from approximately 0.4 at layer 15 to around 0.5 at layer 17, before rising sharply to approximately 2.6 at layer 21 and then dipping slightly to around 2.5 at layer 23. The second line is an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate" with a reported average of 0.05. It remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, showing only a very slight increase toward the final layers, reaching approximately 0.1 by layer 23. The third line is a green dashed line representing "hidden state mean of baseline" with a reported average of 0.04. It also stays very close to 0 across all layers, with a similarly slight increase toward the end, reaching roughly 0.08–0.1 by layer 23. The orange and green lines are nearly overlapping and remain close to the x-axis throughout the entire range.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm mit dem Titel „Hidden State Mean" stellt den absoluten Mittelwert von Hidden States über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells dar, wobei drei verschiedene Bedingungen verglichen werden. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0,5 (0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5). Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil und ohne sichtbare Markierungen, repräsentiert „hidden state mean before gate" mit einem angegebenen Durchschnitt von 0,71; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,2 bis 0,3 im Bereich von Layer 3 bis 10, bleibt dort relativ stabil, beginnt ab Layer 12 allmählich zu steigen auf etwa 0,5 bei Layer 17, und zeigt dann einen starken Anstieg auf etwa 2,6 bei Layer 21, gefolgt von einem leichten Rückgang auf etwa 2,5 bei Layer 23. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil, repräsentiert „hidden state mean after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,05; sie verläuft nahezu konstant nahe 0 über den gesamten Bereich der Schichten, mit nur minimalen Schwankungen, und erreicht am Ende bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 0,1. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt in Grün mit Strich-Punkt-Linienstil, repräsentiert „hidden state mean of baseline" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,04; sie verläuft ebenfalls nahezu konstant nahe 0 über alle Schichten hinweg und endet bei Layer 23 bei einem Wert von etwa 0,08.
